messages:
noah: quick flag - a customer found multiple invoice lines that trace back to silent v1 fallbacks. they want an "explain" link in the invoice UI.
tara: ugh. is this the same mismatch where dashboards showed tokens for v2 but billing charged v1?
noah: yup. we currently emit intended_model in some places and served_model in others.
ben: short fix: add a routing_id to every request and persist it through traces -> metrics -> billing. then the invoice UI can surface that id and a small drilldown.
sam.k: sdk change: when served_model != requested_model include a structured warn + routing_id in the response so apps can log it. example: `{"served_model":"redwood-v1","requested_model":"redwood-v2","routing_id":"r-abc123","warning":"MODEL_MISMATCH"}`
tara: console: show a served-model badge on request logs and add a per-route "deny fallback" toggle (off by default). also surface last 24h fallback count.
billing-bot: FYI @finance - adding routing_id and billed_rate_tag to billing events. please confirm we can consume these fields.
noah: rollout proposal: phase 1 = emit routing_id + telemetry only (no behavior change). phase 2 = SDK warnings + invoice drilldown. phase 3 = per-route strict toggle + header `X-Redwood-Fallback: deny`.
deploy-bot: I'll open the feature-flagged rollout and schedule infra RFC.
ben: tests: integration test should assert routing_id is present end-to-end for a simulated fallback.
tara: timeline: aim for phase1 in 10 business days so CSMs can start outreach. owners: infra=ben, sdk=sam.k, console=tara, billing=julia (cc @billing-bot).
noah: thanks. i'll draft the invoice drawer copy and post it to the docs channel for quick review.
